purposeStatement: Shows the user's position in a content hierarchy as a trail of ancestor links ending in the current page; NOT for tabs, menus, or a generic row of links.

antiPatterns.pattern: A hand-rolled <nav> of inline-styled <a> elements joined by a literal '/' or raw-colored span separators
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents hierarchy navigation with raw color/gap literals, fragmenting the type scale and spacing scale and bypassing the registered component.
